note: Re-judged 2026-10-24 (independent auditor, authored none of the change). RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2: "or an AutomaticStart event (Event 3), the local system: - initializes all BGP resources for the peer connection, - sets ConnectRetryCounter to zero" 238bdb62e9 changed the producer peer_run.go::runOnce only to pass rpc.RemoteASOf(settings.PeerAS) into the published peer info; the Idle ManualStart/AutomaticStart handling, resource initialisation and the ConnectRetryCounter reset (fsm.go::handleIdle, byte-identical) are untouched, and the tagged carriers are unchanged, so both clauses stay proven. The re-stamp inside 238bdb62e9 recorded a runOnce fingerprint that does not match HEAD; this judgement re-reads runOnce at HEAD. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgement follows. RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 (Idle), rfc/full/rfc4271.txt:2947-2962: "In response to a ManualStart event (Event 1) or an AutomaticStart event (Event 3), the local system: - initializes all BGP resources for the peer connection, - sets ConnectRetryCounter to zero, - starts the ConnectRetryTimer with the initial value, - initiates a TCP connection to the other BGP peer, - listens for a connection that may be initiated by the remote BGP peer, and - changes its state to Connect." Independently read all five tagged carriers in fsm/rfc4271_connect_retry_test.go and reactor/rfc4271_automatic_start_peer_test.go, plus fsm.go::handleIdle and peer_run.go::runOnce. Implemented-tested: Idle Event 3 resets a seeded counter from 7 to exactly 0 in active/passive modes; Event 6 and non-Idle starts retain the counter. Live peer fixtures create sessions, exchange OPEN/KEEPALIVE, reach Established, end by Cease or hold expiry, and require 1 after failure then 0 on the next dial. A subsequent OpenSent failure must retain 1, discriminating a stale established flag. runOnce creates fresh session resources, supplies the peer-owned counter, consumes cycleReachedEstablished with Swap(false), and selects automatic versus damped start before dialing; the new export-final callback does not alter these steps. Resource initialization is observed through successful real session establishment, not inferred from reset alone; Section 8.2.1.5 leaves its details implementation-dependent. This row does not separately certify every timer/listener obligation in the full Idle action list. No new execution or discrimination observation; semantic source rejudgment only.
